string.text: Heavy knife stab on a dead mutant Uses the corpse (loot claims and auto-loot stay with existing mods). On success, branches into a short rip slash. Setup turns off FDDA Redone skinning anims and enables auto-loot-all. Do not enable Faster Skinning's "Slash to loot mutants" at the same time.

When on, a knife heavy attack on a mutant corpse synthesizes Use. Claimed bodies keep stock PDA tips; free bodies loot via FDDA auto-loot-all, then play a rip slash with movement locked only during that rip.
